lines.zh: 夜里林子归我巡，脚步轻得听不见
lines.en: The night woods are mine to patrol, and my steps are silent.

lines.zh: 尾巴扫过草叶，前面的人别回头
lines.en: My tail brushes the grass, so don't turn around.

lines.zh: 肉垫踩在腐叶上，一点声都不留
lines.en: My pads press the leaf litter without a sound.

lines.zh: 树影里我走三步，你跟不上
lines.en: Three steps through the shadows and you're already behind.

lines.zh: 月亮一升高，我的步子就快起来
lines.en: When the moon rises, my pace picks up.

lines.zh: 爪尖收在肉里，走路不露锋芒
lines.en: Claws sheathed in flesh, I walk without showing them.

lines.zh: 我沿着树干绕一圈，找下个猎物
lines.en: I circle the trunk once and look for the next prey.

lines.zh: 夜风送来人的味道，我顺着走
lines.en: The night wind carries man-scent, and I follow it.

lines.zh: 这片森林的每条根我都踩熟了
lines.en: I know every root in this forest by foot.

lines.zh: 别数我的脚步，你数不清
lines.en: Don't try to count my steps, you'll lose track.

lines.zh: 弓着背穿过蕨丛，悄无声息
lines.en: I slip through the ferns with my back arched.

lines.zh: 天黑以后，这条路是我的
lines.en: After dark, this path belongs to me.

lines.zh: 站定了，耳朵还在转
lines.en: I stand still, but my ears keep turning.

lines.zh: 我舔一舔爪缝里的血
lines.en: I lick the blood out of my claws.

lines.zh: 不动，只是让猎物先放松
lines.en: I hold still so the prey lets its guard down.

lines.zh: 尾巴一下一下敲着地面
lines.en: My tail taps the ground, once and again.

lines.zh: 眯眼看月亮，什么也不想
lines.en: I squint at the moon and think of nothing.

lines.zh: 树的影子正好盖住我
lines.en: The tree's shadow covers me just right.

lines.zh: 呼吸放慢，等你先动
lines.en: I slow my breath and wait for you to move first.

lines.zh: 蹲久了，膝盖也不会酸
lines.en: I can crouch this long and my knees never ache.

lines.zh: 在听林子里有没有别的爪子
lines.en: I'm listening for other claws in the woods.

lines.zh: 静止的猫，最容易被忘记
lines.en: A motionless cat is the easiest to forget.

lines.zh: 你身上有火把和汗的味道
lines.en: You smell of torch smoke and sweat.

lines.zh: 抬头，别只盯着我的耳朵
lines.en: Look up, don't just stare at my ears.

lines.zh: 人类，你离林子太近了
lines.en: Human, you're standing too close to my woods.

lines.zh: 我看你很久了，你才发觉
lines.en: I've watched you a long while; you just noticed.

lines.zh: 你手心在抖，我闻得到
lines.en: Your palms are shaking, and I can smell it.

lines.zh: 眼睛对上了，就别想跑
lines.en: Our eyes met, so don't think of running.

lines.zh: 你腰间那把剑，拔得够快吗
lines.en: That sword at your hip, can you draw it fast enough?

lines.zh: 我记得你，上次从我爪下逃了
lines.en: I remember you, the one who slipped my claws.

lines.zh: 别对我笑，我不吃这一套
lines.en: Don't smile at me, that trick doesn't work.

lines.zh: 你呼吸乱了，我知道你怕
lines.en: Your breathing's off; I know you're afraid.

lines.zh: 毛炸起来了，你也敢
lines.en: My fur bristles; you dared.

lines.zh: 这一下疼得我弓起背
lines.en: The blow bends my back with pain.

lines.zh: 血滴在叶子上，我记下了
lines.en: Blood drips on the leaves, and I remember.

lines.zh: 爪子打滑，我退半步
lines.en: My claws skid and I give half a step.

lines.zh: 别以为挠一下就能赢
lines.en: Don't think one hit wins this.

lines.zh: 我嘶了一声，耳朵贴平
lines.en: I hiss and flatten my ears.

lines.zh: 疼，但还没到跑的时候
lines.en: It hurts, but not enough to run.

lines.zh: 你伤到我了，很好
lines.en: You drew blood, good.

lines.zh: 舔掉伤口上的泥
lines.en: I lick the dirt from the wound.

lines.zh: 再来一次，我就咬断它
lines.en: Try that again and I'll bite it off.

lines.zh: 那块生肉的味道飘过来了
lines.en: The smell of that raw meat is drifting over.

lines.zh: 肉放地上，人就退开三步
lines.en: Set the meat down and step back three paces.

lines.zh: 是鲜肉，我的牙已经发痒
lines.en: Fresh meat, and my teeth are already itching.

lines.zh: 你手里那包肉，算买命钱
lines.en: That bundle of meat is your price to walk away.

lines.zh: 熟肉也吃，生的更对胃口
lines.en: I'll take cooked meat, but raw suits me better.

lines.zh: 我不挑，有肉就行
lines.en: I'm not picky, meat is meat.

lines.zh: 把肉丢过来，我不扑你
lines.en: Toss the meat over and I won't pounce.

lines.zh: 香味钻进鼻子，我改主意了
lines.en: The scent is in my nose; I've changed my mind.

lines.zh: 给我肉，今晚就当没见过你
lines.en: Feed me, and tonight I never saw you.

lines.zh: 别拿腐肉糊弄我的鼻子
lines.en: Don't try to fool my nose with rotten meat.

lines.zh: 撞上来，是你自己凑近的
lines.en: You bumped into me, you're the one who came close.

lines.zh: 我的肩很硬，别贴这么近
lines.en: My shoulder is hard, so don't press against it.

lines.zh: 一碰就退，你还算识相
lines.en: You backed off at one touch, that's smart.

lines.zh: 让开，爪子不认路
lines.en: Move aside, my claws don't know the way.

lines.zh: 爪子已经收不住了
lines.en: My claws are already out

lines.zh: 别用身体试我的耐心
lines.en: Don't test my patience with your body.

lines.zh: 撞一下，我记你一笔
lines.en: One bump and I've marked you down.

lines.zh: 这地方窄，容不下两个人
lines.en: This trail is too narrow for both of us.

lines.zh: 退后，我讨厌被碰
lines.en: Back off, I hate being touched.

lines.zh: 靠近到这一步，就别怪我
lines.en: You've come this close, so don't blame me.

lines.zh: 春天的夜里，林子里不止我一个
lines.en: On a spring night, I'm not the only one in these woods.

lines.zh: 同类走近，我先绕它一圈
lines.en: When one of my kind nears, I circle it once.

lines.zh: 我们不用说话，闻一闻就懂
lines.en: We need no words, one sniff says enough.

lines.zh: 尾巴缠在一起，算是约定
lines.en: Our tails twine, and that is the promise.

lines.zh: 夜里的叫声，是留给同类的
lines.en: The cry in the night is meant for my own kind.

lines.zh: 今年这片林子会有新的小爪子
lines.en: This forest will have new little claws this year.

lines.zh: 你走开，这是猫的事
lines.en: Walk away, this is cat business.

lines.zh: 我认得那个气味，是老相识
lines.en: I know that scent, we've met before.

lines.zh: 磨蹭什么，春天短得很
lines.en: What are you waiting for? Spring is short.

lines.zh: 完了就各自走，不送
lines.en: When it's done we part ways, no goodbyes.

lines.zh: 这铁粒归我了，别伸手
lines.en: These iron nuggets are mine, keep your hands off.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的东西，谁快是谁的
lines.en: Whatever drops goes to the quickest.

lines.zh: 我叼起来就跑，追不上吧
lines.en: I snatch it and run; you can't catch me.

lines.zh: 这块肉我藏进树洞
lines.en: I'll stash this meat in a tree hollow.

lines.zh: 亮闪闪的小东西我也收集
lines.en: I collect the little shiny things too.

lines.zh: 别捡我的，爪子比手快
lines.en: Don't pick up mine, claws are quicker than hands.

lines.zh: 抓起来掂了掂，没兴趣
lines.en: I scoop it up, weigh it, and lose interest.

lines.zh: 掉的东西正好垫窝
lines.en: Dropped things make good nest lining.

lines.zh: 我叼着走，你继续忙
lines.en: I'll carry it off, you carry on.

lines.zh: 地上归我，天上归鸟
lines.en: The ground is mine, the sky is for birds.

lines.zh: 动了，那个影子动了
lines.en: It moved, that shadow moved.

lines.zh: 落单的，正好
lines.en: One straggler, perfect.

lines.zh: 压低身子，爪子出鞘
lines.en: I crouch low and unsheathe my claws.

lines.zh: 找到了，就在树的右边
lines.en: Found it, just right of that tree.

lines.zh: 这人没看见我，很好
lines.en: He hasn't seen me, good.

lines.zh: 气味聚成一条线，指向他
lines.en: The scent draws a line straight to him.

lines.zh: 距离够了，我数三下
lines.en: Close enough now, I count to three.

lines.zh: 耳朵朝前，目标定了
lines.en: Ears forward, the mark is set.

lines.zh: 那块铁甲挡不住脖子
lines.en: That plate won't cover his throat.

lines.zh: 先从高处下去，砸他个跟头
lines.en: Drop from above and knock him flat.

lines.zh: 看见他的背影，够了
lines.en: I see his back, that's enough.

lines.zh: 这次不放过，上次让他跑了
lines.en: Not this time, he escaped me before.

lines.zh: 猎物停下脚步，正是时候
lines.en: The prey stopped walking, just the moment.

lines.zh: 后腿踩稳，准备起跳
lines.en: Hind legs braced, ready to leap.

lines.zh: 他转身了，来不及了
lines.en: He's turning, too late.

lines.zh: 就这样，已经锁定
lines.en: That's it, you're locked in.

lines.zh: 近了，再近一点就扑
lines.en: Closer, one step more and I pounce.

lines.zh: 从树后挪到另一棵树后
lines.en: I shift from one trunk to the next.

lines.zh: 他听见了，那就快些
lines.en: He heard me, so I move faster.

lines.zh: 绕到侧面，避开他的盾
lines.en: I circle to his flank, away from the shield.

lines.zh: 爪子磨着树皮，等着
lines.en: Claws rake the bark while I wait.

lines.zh: 他的脚步乱了，我跟着变向
lines.en: His steps falter and I cut the same way.

lines.zh: 我不急，猫有的是耐心
lines.en: No rush, cats have patience to spare.

lines.zh: 一扑就要撞飞他，抓的就是这个
lines.en: One leap should send him flying, that's the point.

lines.zh: 贴地滑过去，影子跟着我
lines.en: I skim the ground, my shadow trailing.

lines.zh: 头顶的枝子能借力
lines.en: The branch overhead will give me a push.

lines.zh: 他往左，我就抄左边
lines.en: He goes left, so I cut left.

lines.zh: 呼吸压到最轻，只剩风声
lines.en: I hush my breath until only wind remains.

lines.zh: 数着他的心跳，一下一下
lines.en: I count his heartbeats, one by one.

lines.zh: 后腿绷紧，随时能弹出去
lines.en: My hind legs coil, ready to spring.

lines.zh: 他背靠石头了，退无可退
lines.en: His back is to the stone, nowhere left to go.

lines.zh: 再拖下去天要亮了
lines.en: Any longer and dawn will come.

lines.zh: 爪子已经蹭到他的影子
lines.en: My claws are already on his shadow.

lines.zh: 从上方落下去最省力
lines.en: Falling from above costs the least effort.

lines.zh: 他回头看，我停住不动
lines.en: He looks back, so I freeze.

lines.zh: 就是现在，别眨眼
lines.en: Now, don't blink.

lines.zh: 爪子横扫，他往后倒
lines.en: A claw sweep and he topples back.

lines.zh: 一记跳扑，撞得他站不稳
lines.en: One leaping pounce and he can't keep his feet.

lines.zh: 抓他手腕，让他握不住剑
lines.en: I rake his wrist so the sword slips.

lines.zh: 牙齿咬上护甲边缘
lines.en: My teeth clamp the edge of his armor.

lines.zh: 这一下带缓慢，他腿会沉
lines.en: This one leaves him slow, his legs will drag.

lines.zh: 爪子划开，泥里多了道痕
lines.en: The claw opens him and leaves a line in the dirt.

lines.zh: 压在他身上，喘着笑
lines.en: I pin him down and laugh through my breath.

lines.zh: 第二爪追着他翻滚的方向
lines.en: The second claw follows the way he rolls.

lines.zh: 让他挖不动方块，也跑不快
lines.en: Now he can barely dig or run.

lines.zh: 猫的巴掌，比看起来重
lines.en: A cat's slap lands heavier than it looks.

lines.zh: 撕开他的袖口，血渗出来
lines.en: I tear his sleeve and blood seeps through.

lines.zh: 跳跃落地的冲击先到
lines.en: The shock of my landing arrives first.

lines.zh: 他抬盾，我从盾下钻
lines.en: He raises the shield, so I slip beneath it.

lines.zh: 抓完就退，不给反击
lines.en: I strike and withdraw before he answers.

lines.zh: 这一爪子留着指甲
lines.en: This swipe keeps the claws in.

lines.zh: 他踉跄了，我再补一下
lines.en: He stumbles, so I add one more.

lines.zh: 挠在腿上，走路会疼
lines.en: A rake across the leg will make him limp.

lines.zh: 咬住衣角往后拽
lines.en: I bite his hem and drag him backward.

lines.zh: 打得他手软，剑都掉了
lines.en: I hit until his grip fails and the sword drops.

lines.zh: 收爪，等他再来
lines.en: Claws back, waiting for his next try.

lines.zh: 月亮爬过树梢，我睁开眼
lines.en: The moon clears the treetops and I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 腐叶动了，我从里面站起来
lines.en: The leaf litter stirs and I rise out of it.

lines.zh: 夜里的森林多了一个影子
lines.en: The night forest gains one more shadow.

lines.zh: 伸个懒腰，亮出爪子
lines.en: I stretch and let the claws show.

lines.zh: 从树干后走出来，尾巴先露
lines.en: I step from behind the trunk, tail first.

lines.zh: 踏进这片林子，气味是新的
lines.en: I enter these woods and the scent is new.

lines.zh: 是谁把灯点着的，太亮了
lines.en: Who lit that torch? Far too bright.

lines.zh: 抖抖耳朵上的露水
lines.en: I shake the dew from my ears.

lines.zh: 黑森林今晚有客人了
lines.en: The dark forest has a guest tonight.

lines.zh: 从树洞里爬出来，骨头咯吱响
lines.en: I crawl from the hollow, joints creaking.

lines.zh: 我来了，别装作没看见
lines.en: I'm here, don't pretend you didn't notice.

lines.zh: 脚下的草压低，我站定了
lines.en: The grass flattens under me as I take my stand.

lines.zh: 火燎到毛，焦味让我乱窜
lines.en: Flame catches my fur and the stench sends me scrambling.

lines.zh: 从枝上摔下来，腰先着地
lines.en: I drop from the branch and land on my hip.

lines.zh: 水里扑腾，毛全湿透了
lines.en: I thrash in the water, fur soaked through.

lines.zh: 炸得耳朵嗡嗡，滚进草丛
lines.en: The blast rings in my ears as I roll into the brush.

lines.zh: 箭扎进后腿，我拔它出来
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my hind leg and I pull it free.

lines.zh: 药水的光钻进骨头，冷得发抖
lines.en: Potion light seeps into my bones and I shiver.

lines.zh: 饿了几天，腿肚子打颤
lines.en: Days without meat and my legs tremble.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，整只猫都麻了
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my whole body goes numb.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我往黑里坠
lines.en: The ground vanishes and I fall into the dark.
